# Protocol messages

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_protocol_reference.py from schema/fovea-protocol-v1.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every event and control message in protocol major version 1, generated from the checked-in [JSON Schema](https://github.com/Wega-Labs/fovea/blob/main/schema/fovea-protocol-v1.json). See [Wire protocol](../protocol.md) for framing, the handshake, and compatibility rules. Consumers must ignore unknown fields and event types.

## Events

Written to stdout, one JSON object per line. `type` identifies the event.

### `gaze_point`

A calibrated gaze coordinate in an adapter-defined coordinate space.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"gaze_point"` | yes |
| `x` | number | yes |
| `y` | number | yes |
| `confidence` | number | yes |
| `timestamp_ns` | integer | yes |
| `target_id` | string or null | no |
| `snapped_x` | number or null | no |
| `snapped_y` | number or null | no |
| `pursuit` | boolean | no |
| `latency_ms` | number or null | no |

## Control messages

Written by the host to stdin, one JSON object per line. `cmd` identifies the command.

### `calibrate`

Restart calibration, optionally with a host-supplied target layout.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cmd` | `"calibrate"` | yes |
| `targets` | array of object or null | no |

### `test`

Start the calibrated gaze test, optionally with a host-supplied target layout.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cmd` | `"test"` | yes |
| `targets` | array of object or null | no |

### `targets`

Replace the host-registered targets used for target-aware gaze.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cmd` | `"targets"` | yes |
| `items` | array of object | yes |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |
| `items[].x` | number | yes |
| `items[].y` | number | yes |
| `items[].w` | number | yes |
| `items[].h` | number | yes |
| `space` | `"display_normalized"` | yes |

### `observe`

Report a host-confirmed gaze location for online calibration.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cmd` | `"observe"` | yes |
| `x` | number | yes |
| `y` | number | yes |
| `weight` | number | no |
| `timestamp_ns` | integer or null | no |

### `pause`

Suppress event output without stopping local capture.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cmd` | `"pause"` | yes |

### `resume`

Resume event output after `pause`.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cmd` | `"resume"` | yes |

### `quit`

Close the source and exit cleanly.

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cmd` | `"quit"` | yes |
